---
description: "Update project documentation to reflect the current state of the codebase. Specify which doc files to update or leave blank for all."
agent: "agent"
---
Review the current codebase and update the specified documentation files (or all docs if none specified) to accurately reflect the current state of the project.

**Files to consider updating:**
- [README.md](../../README.md)
- [docs/architecture.md](../../docs/architecture.md)
- [docs/build.md](../../docs/build.md)
- [docs/deployment.md](../../docs/deployment.md)

**Process:**
1. Read the target documentation files
2. Explore the codebase for current routes, models, components, scripts, and dependencies
3. Identify outdated, missing, or inaccurate sections
4. Update the documentation to match the actual codebase — add new sections for new features, remove references to removed features, fix incorrect commands or paths
5. Preserve the existing tone and formatting style of each document

**Rules:**
- Only update documentation files — do not modify source code
- Keep descriptions concise and accurate
- Preserve any diagrams, badges, or media references
- If a section is already accurate, leave it unchanged
